query: WITH latest_snapshot AS (SELECT MAX(SNAPSHOT) AS latest_date FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala), input AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS population_count FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala pop JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location loc ON pop.id = loc.id WHERE pop.is_in_population = TRUE AND loc.city = 'الطائف' AND pop.snapshot = (SELECT latest_date FROM latest_snapshot)) SELECT input.*, poly.wkt FROM input CROSS JOIN ESTISHRAF_LLM_KSA_Cities_Polygons poly WHERE poly.city = 'الطائف'
raw_question: كم عدد السكان في مدينة الطائف؟ رد كالتالي: "عدد السكان (الرقم)"
